sloka: प्राकारेण परिक्षिप्ता पाण्डुरेण विराजिता ।हेम कक्ष्या पुरी रम्या वैदूर्यमय तोरणा ॥३-४८-११॥
transliteration: prākāreṇa parikṣiptā pāṇḍureṇa virājitā ।hema kakṣyā purī ramyā vaidūryamaya toraṇā ॥3-48-11॥

translations.english: The beautiful city of Lanka shines with its pale white ramparts and golden interiors. The entrance gates are encrusted with vaidurya (cat'seye).
